body:
This breaks tab drag and drop because of how tab bar and tab container handle it.
- related https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/8887
Hidden tabs aren't used in docks anymore right?
It refers to tabs that aren't currently selected, see #25353

I can add `tab_hovered` signal to handle that.
But now I wonder if switch on hover should be built-in in the TabBar. That was my original idea, but I went with more local approach, as I needed it only for docks.

I think its a common enough feature that it can be added to TabBar. We might want it for scene tab bar in the future too.
I can also look into fixing #8887
I don't really like how we do this in a const method, but it happens a lot in `can_drop_data` and the current alternatives aren't great. So its fine for now.

@@ -1273,11 +1273,9 @@ Variant TabBar::_handle_get_drag_data(const String &p_type, const Point2 &p_poin
 
 bool TabBar::_handle_can_drop_data(const String &p_type, const Point2 &p_point, const Variant &p_data) const {
body: This does not get called when `drag_to_rearrange_enabled` is not enabled, so the `can_drop_data` for this and TabContainer should be changed to also check `switch_on_hover`.

```suggestion
	if (drag_to_rearrange_enabled && type == p_type) {
```
This now needs to check drag_to_rearrange_enabled itself.

Though I don't think this will work with TabContainer.

```suggestion
	if (!drag_to_rearrange_enabled) {
```

This isn't needed in drop data.
Same in TabContainer.

> Though I don't think this will work with TabContainer.

What do you mean?

EDIT:
Ok, I see.

diff_hunk:
@@ -270,6 +270,9 @@
 		<member name="select_with_rmb" type="bool" setter="set_select_with_rmb" getter="get_select_with_rmb" default="false">
 			If [code]true[/code], enables selecting a tab with the right mouse button.
 		</member>
+		<member name="switch_on_hover" type="bool" setter="set_switch_on_hover" getter="get_switch_on_hover" default="true">
body: I think this could be renamed to `switch_on_drag_hover` to be more clear, since at a glance it seems like it would work without dragging.

Note that changing this means that some users may need to update it as well, see https://github.com/gilzoide/godot-dockable-container/pull/24
Maybe instead we could keep the type the same and add a `drag_data["is_rearrange_tab"] = true` or something.
We should also consider making this available in the TabContainer inspector.

idk, consistent type makes more sense.
Technically this is not part of the API, so compatibility is not a concern here.
Now that #110904 has been merged, you could use the new `interface/editor/dragging_hover_wait_seconds` setting here.
It's an editor setting, so it can't be used here easily.
Just do it like it's done on the PR itself, make it a theme constant, so it can be set in the project and editor themes.
